feed.title: NPR Topics: Politics
feed.subtitle: NPR's expanded coverage of U.S. and world politics, the latest news from Congress and the White House and elections.

entry.title: New White House press secretary a 'devoted fan' of Trump and MAGA
entry.summary: Katie Zacharia worked for one of Trump's companies and raised her profile appearing on conservative-leaning talk shows. She also amplified right-wing conspiracy theories. Now she'll be the president's chief spokesperson.

entry.title: Government spent $10 million on pro-Trump ads after president said super PAC would fund
entry.summary: Nearly $22 million in taxpayers funds has been spent to air the ads, with nearly half spent after Trump promised to fund what the White House calls public service announcements through his super PAC.

entry.title: Democratic senator talks Trump's Russian diesel deal
entry.summary: NPR's Steve Inskeep speaks to Democratic Senator Jeanne Shaheen of New Hampshire about President Trump's deal for Russian diesel and his claim of an "energy ceasefire" that did not materialize.

entry.title: Political strategist on how Trump's personal grievances could affect the GOP
entry.summary: NPR's Steve Inskeep speaks with political strategist and former senior Republican congressional adviser Rina Shah about how President Trump's personal grievances and projects are affecting the chances of GOP candidates in the upcoming election.

entry.title: Trump struggles to show voters he's focused on the cost of living
entry.summary: With a deal to import millions of tons of diesel fuel from Russia, President Trump is struggling to show voters that he is focused on the cost of living ahead of the midterms.

entry.title: Texas' 15th Congressional District provides clues to state's Latino vote
entry.summary: The 15th Congressional District runs from the east of San Antonio all the way down into the Rio Grande Valley. This majority-Latino district provides a window into the Latino vote in Texas.

entry.title: Justice Department investigates TV networks, citing possible anti-trust violations
entry.summary: The move escalates Trump's fight with the press amid court battle over barring CNN, Politico and MS NOW from the White House.

entry.title: Politics chat: Trump announces fuel deal with Russia. What does it mean for sanctions?
entry.summary: President Trump announced a deal to import Russian fuel to the U.S. We look at what this means for the sanctions he recently signed off on against Russia, as well as the U.S.'s support for Ukraine.

entry.title: In one of the country's most competitive districts, a Democrat tries to keep her seat
entry.summary: In a highly competitive Washington congressional race, the incumbent Democrat has angered part of her party base and the Trump-backed Republican challenger faces backlash against the party in power.
